leads.role: Assistant Director of Planning & Community Development
leads.name: Mary Church
leads.notes: Primary contact for business permits and zoning. Department handles Engineering, Housing, Fair Housing, Grants, Code Enforcement, and Zoning. Alternative email domain: mchurch@ashtabulacity.com also referenced on Economic Development page.

leads.name: James M. Timonere
responsibilities: Head of all city departments (except Solicitor, Finance, Municipal Court, Board of Health)
leads.notes: Executive-level contact for business licensing initiatives. Oversees all city operations and can direct to appropriate departments. Executive Assistant: Kelli Jones (kjones@cityofashtabula.com).

research_notes: Business licensing in Ashtabula is managed through the Planning & Community Development department. The department handles zoning permits, code enforcement, and business-related permits. Mary Church is the Assistant Director and primary point of contact. For high-level business initiatives, City Manager James Timonere is the appropriate executive contact.
